candidate.answerReason: The line is vertical, so its horizontal change is zero and its slope is undefined.

methods.label: Inclination and tangent
methods.explanation: The angle of inclination is \(90^\circ\), whose tangent is undefined, so the slope is undefined.
methods.levelReason: Uses the prescribed slope definition and the earlier fact that tangent is undefined at 90 degrees.

methods.label: Zero horizontal change
methods.explanation: A line perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis is vertical. Two distinct points on it have zero horizontal change and nonzero vertical change. Slope is vertical change divided by horizontal change, so it would require division by \(0\). Thus the slope is undefined, choice A.
methods.levelReason: Uses coordinate changes and division restrictions, without requiring trigonometry.
